translations.literal: Yanhui sent his deputy commander Cao Dechang to lead stalwart men at night through the water sluice; inside and outside they lit fires in concert, and the city was thrown into alarm and disorder; Yanhui beat drums, smashed the gate, and entered; Yangong fled in a light boat to Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: Yanhui sent Cao Dechang with picked men through the water gate by night; fires flared inside and out, the city panicked, Yanhui drummed through the shattered gate, and Yangong fled downriver in a light craft to Guangling.

sentences.zh: 彥暉虜其弟彥雄，送於大梁。

translations.literal: Yanhui captured his younger brother Yanxiong and sent him to the Great Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Yanhui seized his brother Yanxiong and sent him to the Great Liang.

sentences.zh: 淮南以彥恭為節度副使。

translations.literal: Huainan made Yangong military governor deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan appointed Yangong deputy military governor.

sentences.zh: 先是，澧州刺史向瑰與彥恭相表裡，至是亦降於楚，楚始得澧、朗二州。

translations.literal: Earlier, Li Prefecture governor Xiang Gui had been in league with Yangong; now he too surrendered to Chu, and Chu for the first time gained Li and Lang, the two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xiang Gui of Lizhou had colluded with Yangong; now he too submitted to Chu, and Chu at last held Lizhou and Langzhou.

sentences.zh: 蜀主遣將將兵會岐兵五萬攻雍州，晉張承業亦將兵應之。

translations.literal: The Shu sovereign sent generals to lead troops joining fifty thousand Qi troops in attacking Yong Prefecture; Jin's Zhang Chengye also led troops to respond.
translations.idiomatic: The Shu emperor sent generals with an army to join fifty thousand Qi troops against Yongzhou; Zhang Chengye of Jin marched to meet them.

sentences.zh: 六月，壬寅，以劉知俊為西路行營都招討使以拒之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day Renyin, Liu Zhijun was made supreme commander of the western-route campaign army to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renyin, Liu Zhijun was made supreme commander of the western-route army to oppose them.

sentences.zh: 金吾上將軍王師範家於洛陽，朱友寧之妻泣訴於帝曰：「陛下化家為國，宗族皆蒙榮寵。

translations.literal: The Golden Crow Guard superior general Wang Shifan's family was in Luoyang; Zhu Youning's wife wept and pleaded before the Emperor, saying, "Your Majesty has transformed his house into the state, and the whole clan has received glory and favor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shifan, superior general of the Golden Crow Guard, kept his household in Luoyang; Zhu Youning's wife came weeping before the Emperor: "Your Majesty turned kin into empire, and our clan has bathed in favor.

sentences.zh: 妾夫獨不幸，因王師範叛逆，死於戰場。

translations.literal: My husband alone was unlucky; because of Wang Shifan's rebellion, he died on the battlefield.
translations.idiomatic: I alone was left a widow—my husband fell in battle when Wang Shifan rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 今仇讎猶在，妾誠痛之！」

translations.literal: Now the enemy still lives—your servant truly grieves!"
translations.idiomatic: His killer still walks free—and the wound still bleeds."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「朕幾忘此賊！」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I nearly forgot this villain!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "I had nearly forgotten that villain!"

sentences.zh: 已酉，遣使就洛陽族之。

translations.literal: On the day Yiyou, he sent an envoy to Luoyang to exterminate the clan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day Yiyou he dispatched an envoy to Luoyang to wipe out Wang's entire clan.

sentences.zh: 使者先鑿坑於第側，乃宣敕告之。

translations.literal: The envoy first dug a pit beside the residence, then proclaimed the edict and informed them.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy dug a pit beside the mansion first, then read the imperial order aloud.

sentences.zh: 師範盛陳宴具，與宗族列坐，謂使者曰：「死者人所不免，況有罪乎！

translations.literal: Shifan lavishly set out banquet vessels; with his clan seated in rows he said to the envoy: "Death is unavoidable for all men—how much more for the guilty!
translations.idiomatic: Shifan laid out a full feast and seated his kinsmen in ranks. He told the envoy, "Every man must die—what shame is there in dying guilty?

sentences.zh: 予不欲使積屍長幼無序。」

translations.literal: I do not wish to leave piled corpses with elders and juniors out of order."
translations.idiomatic: I will not have corpses heaped with elders and juniors out of their proper order."

sentences.zh: 酒既行，命自幼及長，引於坑中戮之，死者凡二百人。

translations.literal: Once the wine had circulated, he ordered them led from the youngest to the eldest into the pit and slaughtered; the dead numbered two hundred in all.
translations.idiomatic: When the wine had gone round, he had them led into the pit from youngest to eldest; two hundred died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，劉知俊及佑國節度使王重師大破岐兵於幕谷，晉、蜀兵皆引歸。

translations.literal: On the day Bingchen, Liu Zhijun together with Youguo military governor Wang Zhongshi inflicted a great defeat on Qi troops at Muguli; Jin and Shu armies both withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On Bingchen, Liu Zhijun and Wang Zhongshi, the Youguo military governor, routed the Qi army at Muguli; the Jin and Shu forces withdrew.

sentences.zh: 蜀立遂王宗懿為太子。

translations.literal: Shu established the Prince of Sui, Zongyi, as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Shu named Prince of Sui Zongyi crown prince.

sentences.zh: 帝欲自將擊潞州，丁卯，詔會諸道兵。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to lead the attack on Luzhou in person; on the day Dingmao he decreed that troops from all circuits assemble.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor meant to lead the Luzhou campaign himself. On Dingmao he ordered the armies of every circuit to muster.

sentences.zh: 湖南判官高郁請聽民自採茶賣於北客，收其征以贍軍，楚王殷從之。

translations.literal: Hunan adjutant Gao Yu asked that the people be allowed to pick tea themselves and sell it to northern merchants, collecting tax to supply the army; Chu King Yin assented.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yu, a Hunan staff officer, proposed letting commoners harvest tea and sell it to northern traders, using the levy to feed the army; King Ma Yin of Chu agreed.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，殷奏於汴、荊、襄、唐、郢、復州置回圖務，運茶於河南、北，賣之以易繒纊、戰馬而歸，仍歲貢茶二十五萬斤，詔許之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Yin memorialized that tea-trading offices be set up at Bian, Jing, Xiang, Tang, Ying, and Fu prefectures, transporting tea to the regions north and south of the Yellow River, selling it to obtain silks and fine silks and war horses to return with, while still presenting twenty-five ten-thousand jin of tea yearly as tribute—the edict granted it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Yin petitioned to establish tea offices at Bian, Jing, Xiang, Tang, Ying, and Fu, shipping leaf north and south of the river to trade for silks and war horses—and still offering two hundred fifty thousand jin in annual tribute. The court approved.

sentences.zh: 湖南由是富贍。

translations.literal: Hunan from this became wealthy and well supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan grew rich.

sentences.zh: 壬申，淮南將吏請於李儼，承制授楊隆演淮南節度使、東面諸道行營都統、同平章事、弘農王。

translations.literal: On the day Renshen, Huainan's generals and officials requested of Li Yan that, by interim edict, Yang Longyan be appointed Huainan military governor, commander-in-chief of the eastern circuits' field armies, associate grand councillor, and Prince of Hongnong.
translations.idiomatic: On Renshen the Huainan commanders petitioned Li Yan to grant, by provisional mandate, Yang Longyan the posts of Huainan military governor, supreme commander of eastern campaigns, associate grand councillor, and Prince of Hongnong.

sentences.zh: 鍾泰章賞薄，泰章未嘗自言；

translations.literal: Zhong Taizhang's rewards had been meager; Taizhang had never spoken of it himself;
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Taizhang had been poorly rewarded for his service, yet he had never said a word;

sentences.zh: 後逾年，因醉與諸將爭言而及之。

translations.literal: more than a year later, while drunk he quarreled with the generals in speech and the matter came up.
translations.idiomatic: more than a year later, drunk, he quarreled with fellow officers and the grievance slipped out.

sentences.zh: 或告徐溫，以泰章怨望，請誅之，溫曰：「是吾過也。」

translations.literal: Someone reported to Xu Wen that Taizhang harbored resentment and asked that he be put to death; Wen said: "This is my fault."
translations.idiomatic: Someone told Xu Wen that Taizhang nursed a grudge and ought to be killed. Wen said, "That fault is mine."

sentences.zh: 擢為滁州刺史。

translations.literal: He was promoted to be prefect of Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He promoted him to prefect of Chuzhou.
